title: Bayer et al.'s homotopy conjecture for total cut complexes of squared cycles
statement:
Let $W_n$ be the squared cycle graph with $n$ vertices, and let 
$$
be the total cut complex of $W_n$.

**Bayer et al.'s conjecture.** The $(n-k-1)$-dimensional complex
$$
 is the void complex if $n
e 3k+i$ for the relevant ranges below; otherwise, it is homotopy equivalent to a single sphere in dimension

$$
\begin{cases}
2i+1, & n=3k+i, \ 0\le i\le k-1,\\
2k+i, & n=4k+i, \ i\ge 0.
\end{cases}
$$

This conjecture predicts the homotopy type of total cut complexes for squared cycle graphs, extending the known description for ordinary cycles. The source does not provide evidence of a resolution.
source_name: Yufeng Shen, Zhiyu Song, Fenglin Yu, Leopold Wuhan Zhou and Jingqi Zhuang, “Homotopy Type of Total Cut Complexes of Squared Cycle Graphs”, arXiv:2510.22574 (2025).
references:
